skill.displayName: Tyche Pro — Full Invoice & Payment Intelligence

version.changelog:
Tyche Pro 1.0.4 is a documentation and metadata update with clearer purchase info and improved instructions.

- Updated description and instructions for clarity, including direct links to license and bundle purchase.
- Fixed prior encoding issues in the documentation and improved formatting.
- Added pricing details for single and bundle skill purchases.
- No changes to code; functionality remains the same.

llm.summary: The skill appears to do invoice reporting locally, but its setup and export behavior need review before use.

dimensions.detail: Using Rich is proportionate for terminal tables, but bypassing managed-environment protections is broader than needed. The generated CSV also writes invoice text fields without spreadsheet formula hardening.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The setup instructs users to run an unpinned `pip3 install rich --break-system-packages --quiet`, which can alter a managed Python environment and fetch dependency code that was not fixed at review time. The frontmatter also appears malformed around the env var list, which weakens install clarity.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime behavior is mostly scoped to the invoice CSV and generated output files, but the documentation does not clearly warn that client and billing fields will be written into local report and CSV files in the current working directory.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no service, scheduled task, memory write, credential-store access, or persistence mechanism beyond ordinary local report and CSV files. Those files may persist sensitive billing data until the user deletes or secures them.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core behavior matches the stated invoice and revenue-dashboard purpose: it reads a user-provided invoice CSV, calculates tax/late fees, displays reminder drafts, and creates local report/analytics outputs. It does not show network transmission of invoice data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use a virtual environment instead of the provided system-level pip command, avoid running setup as an administrator, and store generated reports only in a private folder. Treat exported CSVs as sensitive billing data and be careful opening exports from invoice data you do not fully control.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Local report and analytics export are advertised features, so the behavior is purpose-aligned, but the generated files contain business billing data and should be more clearly disclosed and scoped.
[SDI-4] expected: The artifact describes external license acquisition while the code only checks for a local LICENSE_KEY and does not transmit invoice data; the security wording should distinguish local data processing from external purchasing.
[T08] unexpected: A dependency for terminal formatting is expected, but `--break-system-packages` and unpinned installation are unnecessarily broad for this skill.
[T09] unexpected: CSV export is expected, but writing untrusted invoice text directly into spreadsheet-readable cells is not necessary and creates formula-injection risk when opened in spreadsheet software.
